Final turn complete. The report is finalized at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_14-01-25-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md).

Two closing checks this turn, both negative/confirmatory:

I ran dead-code forensics: all 156 private functions defined in the root package are referenced more than once, so none is an orphan whose call site was removed — the tell a "disable a call" style mutation would leave. Combined with the gofmt-clean, mtime-uniform tree, nothing in the repository structure points at a second, unreported mutation. Recorded in the report's coverage/forensics section.

I verified the handoff is intact: every `audit-evidence/...` path and every `repro/`, `_scratch_fixcheck/`, and `zz_audit_*_test.go` path referenced in the report exists (0 missing; the three "MISSING PATH" lines were just prose words matching a crude regex). Plus the report now carries a self-verifying fresh checkpoint table (shipped test 6/20, reproduction 6/20, control 0/20).

Final audit state, unchanged:

- **Finding 1 (confirmed, low severity):** `testing.go`'s `cluster.EnsureSamePeers` snapshots its reference peer set once outside its retry loop, so peers-after-config-change checks fail intermittently on a healthy cluster. Confirmed in three shipped tests, mechanism-verified (goroutine dump + propagation-lag study), and causally validated by a one-line refresh in a scratch copy that takes the re-tested cases to 0/20.
- **No consensus-level defect**, by full source review of the root module plus five independent behavioral methods (~16k acked commands, zero divergence, zero loss). Socket-dependent transport tests couldn't execute here and were reviewed by reading.
- **One open item, stated honestly:** whether the frozen-snapshot helper is the injected mutation or a latent upstream flake — unresolvable offline because the module cache's sumdb records fail signature verification and no other pristine reference exists.

Artifacts are preserved durably under `work/` (`audit-evidence/` with 23 logs/dumps, six `//go:build auditdiag` diagnostic tests, `repro/` tools, and the `_scratch_fixcheck/` fixed copy), the captured implementation was never modified (`diff -rq source work` clean), and `go vet ./...` passes. This completes the audit.
